card-headline.purpose: The one sentence on a bridge card; scales 1 / 0.86 / 0.74 by length.

card-one-liner.purpose: Supporting line under the card headline, Dusk Muted.

card-name.purpose: Uppercase full name under each portrait; 26u past 22 characters.

display.purpose: Person name on a person page (3rem below 640px); other page titles 3rem.

body.purpose: Reading text; 65ch cap on prose pages.

caption.purpose: Axis ticks, proof-line dates, source and licence notes.

shadows.name: gap-ring
shadows.purpose: Separates the bridge portrait from the endpoints it overlaps.

shadows.name: lifeline-lift
shadows.purpose: Lifts lifeline segments off the faces.

shadows.name: pulse-ring
shadows.purpose: End state of the overlap-dot pulse (starts at 0 0 0 0 / 0.7).

motion.name: lifeline-draw
motion.purpose: Each lifeline segment draws in left to right.

motion.name: lifeline-pulse
motion.purpose: Overlap dot scales to 1.6 with an expanding ring, once.

motion.name: card-exit
motion.purpose: Current bridge leaves in the swipe direction.

motion.name: card-enter
motion.purpose: Next bridge arrives from the side it came from.

motion.name: bar-grow
motion.purpose: Timeline bars on the proof side.

motion.name: snap-back
motion.purpose: A short drag that doesn't pass the threshold returns to rest.

components.name: Pill Button
components.description: Quiet outlined pill under the card: 'how?' and 'Share'.
components.html: <button class="ds-pill" type="button"><svg width="20" height="20" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.8" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M12 3v12M7 8l5-5 5 5M5 14v5a2 2 0 0 0 2 2h10a2 2 0 0 0 2-2v-5"/></svg> Share</button>
components.css: .ds-pill { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; height: 44px; padding: 0 20px; border-radius: 9999px; border: 1px solid var(--rule, #34385a); background: transparent; color: var(--ink, #e9eaf3); font: 500 0.875rem/1.43 var(--font-hanken, 'Hanken Grotesk'), system-ui, sans-serif; cursor: pointer; transition: border-color 150ms cubic-bezier(0.4,0,0.2,1); } .ds-pill:hover { border-color: var(--ink, #e9eaf3); } .ds-pill:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--focus, #7d89ff); outline-offset: 3px; } .ds-pill:disabled { opacity: 0.3; border-color: var(--rule, #34385a); }

components.name: Round Button
components.html: <button class="ds-round" type="button" aria-label="Next bridge"><svg width="24" height="24" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.8" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M9 5l7 7-7 7"/></svg></button>
components.css: .ds-round { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; width: 44px; height: 44px; border-radius: 9999px; border: 1px solid var(--rule, #34385a); background: transparent; color: var(--ink, #e9eaf3); cursor: pointer; transition: border-color 150ms cubic-bezier(0.4,0,0.2,1); } .ds-round:hover { border-color: var(--ink, #e9eaf3); } .ds-round:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--focus, #7d89ff); outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Edge Arrow
components.description: Desktop-only 64px borderless arrow at the screen edge.
components.html: <button class="ds-edge" type="button" aria-label="Next bridge"><svg width="36" height="36" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.8" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M9 5l7 7-7 7"/></svg></button>
components.css: .ds-edge { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; width: 64px; height: 64px; border-radius: 9999px; border: 0; background: transparent; color: var(--muted, #9ea1b8); cursor: pointer; transition: background-color 150ms, color 150ms; } .ds-edge:hover { background: var(--paper-2, #1d2038); color: var(--ink, #e9eaf3); } .ds-edge:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--focus, #7d89ff); outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Person Search
components.description: Pill search field; border turns ultramarine on focus.
components.html: <input class="ds-search" type="search" placeholder="Search anyone — Einstein, Cleopatra, Beyoncé…" aria-label="Find a person">
components.css: .ds-search { width: 100%; max-width: 420px; padding: 12px 20px; border-radius: 9999px; border: 1px solid var(--rule, #34385a); background: var(--paper-2, #1d2038); color: var(--ink, #e9eaf3); font: 400 1rem/1.5 var(--font-hanken, 'Hanken Grotesk'), system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-search::placeholder { color: var(--muted, #9ea1b8); } .ds-search:focus { outline: none; border-color: var(--bridge, #7d89ff); }

components.name: Feed Header
components.description: 56px blurred header with the Gloock wordmark and menu button.
components.html: Alive At Once
components.css: .ds-header { display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; height: 56px; padding: 0 16px; background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--paper, #15172b) 70%, transparent); backdrop-filter: blur(12px); border-bottom: 1px solid color-mix(in srgb, var(--rule, #34385a) 40%, transparent); color: var(--ink, #e9eaf3); } .ds-wordmark { font: 400 1.25rem/1.4 var(--font-gloock, Gloock), Georgia, serif; color: inherit; text-decoration: none; } .ds-wordmark:focus-visible, .ds-menu:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--focus, #7d89ff); outline-offset: 3px; } .ds-menu { padding: 8px; margin-right: -8px; border: 0; border-radius: 9999px; background: transparent; color: inherit; cursor: pointer; } .ds-menu:hover { background: var(--paper-2, #1d2038); }

components.name: Share Sheet Row
components.description: Icon, title and muted hint in a 16px-rounded hover row.
components.css: .ds-row { display: flex; width: 100%; max-width: 360px; align-items: center; gap: 16px; padding: 14px 16px; border: 0; border-radius: 16px; background: transparent; color: var(--ink, #e9eaf3); text-align: left; font-family: var(--font-hanken, 'Hanken Grotesk'), system-ui, sans-serif; cursor: pointer; } .ds-row:hover, .ds-row:focus-visible { background: var(--paper-2, #1d2038); outline: none; } .ds-row-title { display: block; font-weight: 500; } .ds-row-hint { display: block; font-size: 0.875rem; color: var(--muted, #9ea1b8); }

components.name: Toast
components.description: Inverted pill confirmation that fades up and leaves after 2.2s.
components.css: .ds-toast { display: inline-block; padding: 8px 16px; border-radius: 9999px; background: var(--ink, #e9eaf3); color: var(--paper, #15172b); font: 500 0.875rem/1.43 var(--font-hanken, 'Hanken Grotesk'), system-ui, sans-serif; box-shadow: 0 10px 15px -3px rgb(0 0 0 / 0.1), 0 4px 6px -4px rgb(0 0 0 / 0.1); animation: ds-fade-up 300ms ease-out both; } @keyframes ds-fade-up { from { opacity: 0; transform: translateY(8px); } to { opacity: 1; transform: none; } } @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) { .ds-toast { animation: none; } }

components.name: Lifeline
components.description: Signature three-segment lifeline in gold, ultramarine and magenta, with a pulsing overlap year.
components.html: 18821972
components.css: .ds-ll { position: relative; width: 100%; max-width: 480px; height: 72px; background: #15172b; } .ds-ll-seg { position: absolute; top: 50px; height: 4px; border-radius: 3px; box-shadow: 0 0 6px rgba(0,0,0,0.6); transform-origin: left center; animation: ds-draw 460ms cubic-bezier(0.4,0,0.2,1) both; animation-delay: calc(var(--i) * 370ms + 150ms); } .ds-ll-mark { position: absolute; top: 8px; display: flex; flex-direction: column; align-items: center; transform: translateX(-50%); } .ds-ll-year { padding: 2px 8px; border-radius: 9999px; background: rgba(21,23,43,0.82); color: #e9eaf3; font: 700 0.8rem/1.3 var(--font-hanken, 'Hanken Grotesk'), system-ui, sans-serif; letter-spacing: 0.03em; font-feature-settings: "tnum" 1; } .ds-ll-dot { width: 12px; height: 12px; margin-top: 8px; border-radius: 50%; background: #e9eaf3; border: 3px solid #7d89ff; animation: ds-pulse 650ms ease-out 900ms both; } @keyframes ds-draw { from { transform: scaleX(0); } to { transform: scaleX(1); } } @keyframes ds-pulse { 0% { transform: scale(1); box-shadow: 0 0 0 0 rgb(125 137 255 / 0.7); } 45% { transform: scale(1.6); box-shadow: 0 0 0 10px rgb(125 137 255 / 0); } 100% { transform: scale(1); } } @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) { .ds-ll-seg, .ds-ll-dot { animation: none; } }

components.name: Headline
components.description: Gloock headline with its one italic ultramarine emphasis.
components.css: .ds-headline { margin: 0; max-width: 560px; font: 400 2.5rem/1.08 var(--font-gloock, Gloock), Georgia, serif; color: #e9eaf3; text-align: center; text-wrap: balance; background: #15172b; padding: 16px; } .ds-headline em { font-style: italic; color: #7d89ff; }

narrative.overview:
Each bridge is a single cinematic frame: a midnight-ink screen, three portraits lit out of the dark, a lifeline drawn across the top, and one big serif headline. It's bold through scale, contrast and cutting, not through chrome. The card fills the viewport, and moving to the next card is a cut: the old frame slides 28% away and fades, and the new one comes in from the side the swipe came from. The photographs feel archival: earlier faces arrive sepia or black-and-white, modern ones in full colour, so the jump across centuries is visible before anyone reads a date.

The frame works like a film: dark ground, hard-lit subjects, minimal UI. The palette stays cold and quiet so the portraits, the three meaning colours and the italic ultramarine emphasis carry all the punch. Controls are quiet outlined pills sitting below the frame. Inner pages (person, about, collections) follow the same type and colour vocabulary at reading density, with a light Lamplit Paper scheme that switches to midnight under `prefers-color-scheme: dark`.

Every card is also a still. The live card, the 9:16 story image and the Open Graph image come from the same component and the same unit grid, so a screenshot is always a finished, shareable image.
keyCharacteristics: Always-dark bridge card; portraits are the only strong colour on it.
Three meaning colours: gold for the earlier figure, ultramarine for the bridge life, magenta for the later figure.
Era-filtered portraits (sepia before 1850, mono 1850–1949, colour from 1950).
A Gloock display serif for headlines and Hanken Grotesk for everything else, with tabular lining numerals.
One unit grid (1000u per card width) shared by the live card and the share images.
Flat, tonally layered surfaces; shadows only on things that float.
Motion choreographed around the lifeline: draw, then pulse the overlap years.

rules.name: The Three Lives Rule
rules.body: Gold always means the earlier figure, ultramarine the bridge, magenta the later figure, on every surface (lifeline, timelines, proof lines). Never swap them, and never use them as decoration with no meaning.

rules.name: The Portraits Are the Colour Rule
rules.body: On the bridge card, the only large saturated areas are the portraits. Chrome stays in ink, muted and rule. The meaning colours appear only as thin lines, rings and the headline emphasis.

rules.name: The Always-Night Card Rule
rules.body: The bridge card, face cards and every share image use the `.theme-dark` values whatever the system scheme is. Only the inner pages follow `prefers-color-scheme`.

rules.name: The Serif Shouts, the Sans Proves Rule
rules.body: Gloock is only for headlines and titles. Every name, date, number and credit is in Hanken Grotesk.

rules.name: The One Italic Rule
rules.body: A headline has at most one emphasised phrase, and it is always Gloock italic in Ultramarine Thread. No bold, underline or second colour inside headlines.

rules.name: The One Grid Rule
rules.body: Anything drawn on the card is positioned in `u()` units through `CardArt`, never in px or rem. That is what keeps the live card, the story image and the OG image identical.

rules.name: The Only Floaters Cast Shadows Rule
rules.body: If an element doesn't sit over other content, it gets no shadow. Cards, the header and buttons stay flat.

dos: **Do** keep the bridge card and every share image on Midnight Ink (`.theme-dark`), whatever the system scheme.
**Do** colour the three lives as gold → ultramarine → magenta, in that order, every time.
**Do** apply the era filter to portraits: sepia before 1850, mono 1850–1949, colour from 1950.
**Do** lay out anything on the card in `u()` units through `CardArt`, so the live card and the images match.
**Do** keep controls at 44px or larger, as quiet outlined pills or circles.
**Do** set years and numbers in Hanken Grotesk with tabular lining figures.
**Do** honour `prefers-reduced-motion` by removing every animation and the flip transition.
donts: **Don't** add large saturated fills, gradients or coloured panels to the card. Strong colour on it comes from the portraits.
**Don't** use gold, ultramarine or magenta for anything that isn't one of the three lives (ultramarine also covers focus and the active accent).
**Don't** set names, dates or credits in Gloock, or more than one italic phrase in a headline.
**Don't** put shadows on cards, the header or buttons. Shadows are only for overlays.
**Don't** introduce square corners on controls or containers. The form language is round.
